wings.outlet_axis_qualification: Main: B1 housing mouth local v=+5.55 (mating tip v=-0.15), routed endpoint axis Z10.65. Wing actual housing mouth Y=-35.45: header rear Y=-42.60 plus JST 7.15 mm seated extent (#235 round-2 REPORT.md). This candidate starts at conservative reservation plane Y=-34.95, axis Z5.75, 0.50 mm outside the actual mouth. Add that 0.50 mm straight dress lead as well as 3.40 mm internal tail at the Wing end. Hence Wing 3.90 + Main 3.40 = 7.30 mm total, on top of routed curves. The omitted 0.50 mm lead lies within the own GH reservation already audited against every other body.
